title: Three tool input safety tests fail on Linux x86_64 once the suite builds
description:
indigo_test/unit/test_tool_input_safety.py could not build on Linux: it compiled without -D_GNU_SOURCE (test_runner.h uses nftw) and linked libindigo_client.a without the Avahi libraries. With both fixed in this task, 11 of 14 tests pass; RawCropSafety.test_allocation_read_write_and_close_errors (faults fread1 and fread2: expected a failure exit, got 0 with no output) and GaiaCatalogSafety.test_join_overflow_fails_before_opening_truncated_path (the over-long joined path is opened instead of rejected) fail. They concern indigo_raw_crop and the Gaia catalogue reader, not indigo_prop_tool, and were hidden by the build failure. Next: reproduce each on Linux and macOS and fix the tools or the fault wrapper.
